summary: Wave 6 (Auth Email/Password + Password Reset + Profile Media + UI Preferences + Feed Layout) — 8/8 backend pytest tests PASSED. Frontend flows verified for /join tabs, register, forgot-password success message, reset-password page (invalid token error shown correctly), /perfil/personalizar (all data-testids present, theme-dark toggles data-theme='dark'), providers coming_soon badges present for apple/microsoft/linkedin/facebook/twitter, feed-scroll-sentinel present on home. Found ONE gap: CompaniesPage.onFollow does NOT dispatch pc:follow-change, so following from /empresas will NOT auto-refresh the feed — the requirement is only met from surfaces using FollowButton.jsx.

integration_issues.issue: CompaniesPage (/empresas) uses an inline follow button (data-testid company-follow-<id>) whose onFollow handler calls companyService.follow() but does NOT window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pc:follow-change')). LiveFeed listens for this event, so following a company from /empresas will not trigger automatic feed refresh on /. The FollowButton.jsx component DOES dispatch it, but is not used on CompaniesPage. Likely same for CompanyDetailPage — verify.

action_items: In CompaniesPage.jsx (and CompanyDetailPage if similar), after successful companyService.follow(), dispatch window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pc:follow-change', { detail: { entityType: 'company', entityId: id, following: r.following, count: ... } })) so LiveFeed refreshes automatically. Alternatively, replace the inline button with <FollowButton entityType='company' entityId={c.id} initialFollowing={c.my_following} onChange={...}/>.
critical_code_review_comments: CompaniesPage.onFollow duplicates FollowButton logic but omits the pc:follow-change dispatch → violates the P0 real-time refresh contract.
Password reset endpoint correctly returns generic 200 for both existing and non-existing emails (anti-enumeration).
profile_media_routes correctly gates public streaming path with app_prefix check and enforces MIME whitelist + 8MB cap.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Wave 6 fully green. Frontend UI renders /join (Social + Correo tabs with PRONTO badges), /reset-password (form + invalid-token error message), /perfil/personalizar (all controls with expected data-testids: profile-customize-page, theme-{light,dark,auto}, color-{primary,secondary,accent,button}, profile-media-picture-upload, profile-media-cover-upload, profile-reset-preferences), and Home feed shows feed-scroll-sentinel. Only pending issue is the pc:follow-change dispatch missing from CompaniesPage.onFollow. Once main agent adds the dispatch (or replaces inline button with FollowButton), re-run the follow→feed refresh assertion.
rca of the issue: CompaniesPage.onFollow (src/pages/CompaniesPage.jsx:38-43) only updates local component state after companyService.follow(). LiveFeed.jsx:166 subscribes to 'pc:follow-change' via window.addEventListener, but that event is only fired by FollowButton.jsx:56. Since CompaniesPage renders its own inline button instead of using <FollowButton/>, the event never fires when the user follows from /empresas → LiveFeed's refresh tick never increments → feed does not reload automatically. Reproduction: register user, open /empresas, click '+ Seguir' on any company card, then navigate to /. The feed does not include a fresh signals refetch triggered by the follow. Mitigation: add `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pc:follow-change', { detail: { entityType: 'company', entityId: id, following: r.following } }))` inside CompaniesPage.onFollow after setItems, or replace the inline button with FollowButton.
